detection_pack.sigma:
title: APEX - @arikusi/deepseek-mcp-server: Missing Authentication on Self — Phishing / Credential Harvesting
id: apex-phish-b9ff4bcf
status: experimental
description: |
  Detects phishing email delivery, credential harvesting page access, and browser-based exploitation via phishing links. Covers evasion techniques including URL shorteners and typosquatting.
  Generated by CYBERDUDEBIVASH SENTINEL APEX v184.0
references:
    - https://intel.cyberdudebivash.com
    - https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1566/
author: CYBERDUDEBIVASH SENTINEL APEX
date: 2026/10/24
tags:
    - attack.initial_access
    - attack.t1566
    - attack.t1566.002
    - attack.t1598
logsource:
  category: proxy
detection:
  credential_harvesting_page_indicators:
    cs-uri-stem|contains:
      - '/login.php'
      - '/signin.php'
      - '/verify.php'
      - '/secure-login'
      - '/account-verify'
      - '/password-reset-'
    http-host|contains:
      - 'microsoft-verify'
      - 'paypal-secure'
      - 'google-accounts'
      - 'linkedin-secure'
      - 'office365-login'
      - 'support-microsoft'
  obfuscated_phishing_urls:
    cs-uri-stem|re: '/(secure|verify|update|confirm|account)[0-9]{4,8}/'
    sc-status: 200
  document_macro_download:
    cs-uri-stem|endswith:
      - '.doc'
      - '.docm'
      - '.xls'
      - '.xlsm'
      - '.ppt'
      - '.pptm'
    cs-host|not|contains:
      - 'office.com'
      - 'sharepoint.com'
      - 'onedrive.com'
      - 'dropbox.com'
      - 'google.com'
  condition: credential_harvesting_page_indicators or obfuscated_phishing_urls or document_macro_download
falsepositives:
  - Legitimate login pages at unfamiliar domains during vendor transition
  - Security awareness training phishing simulations
level: high
detection_pack.spl:
| comment "@arikusi/deepseek-mcp-server: Missing Authentication on Self | CVE-2026-55605 | APEX v184.0"

index=network OR index=proxy earliest=-24h
| eval threat_match = if(match(_raw, "(?i)(CVE\-2026\-55605)"), 1, 0)
| where threat_match=1
| eval rule="APEX-CVE-2026-55605", severity="HIGH"
| stats count min(_time) as first_seen max(_time) as last_seen by src_ip, dest_host, rule, severity
| convert timeformat="%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ" ctime(first_seen) ctime(last_seen)
| sort -count
detection_pack.yara:
rule APEX_CVE_2026_55605__PHISHING {
    meta:
        description   = "APEX detection: @arikusi/deepseek-mcp-server: Missing Authentication on Self-Hosted HT"
        cve           = "CVE-2026-55605"
        vuln_class    = "PHISHING"
        author        = "CYBERDUDEBIVASH SENTINEL APEX v184.0"
        date          = "2026-10-24"
        reference     = "https://intel.cyberdudebivash.com"
        severity      = "high"
        mitre_attack  = "T1190"
    strings:
        $phish_form = "type=\"password\"" ascii wide nocase  // Credential form
        $phish_steal = "document.getElementById(\"pass\")" ascii wide nocase  // JS credential theft
        $phish_domain = "microsoft-verify" ascii wide nocase  // Typosquatting indicator
    condition:
        2 of them
}
